open_points.subject: sandbox capability boundary for resource limits
open_points.text: the code runs without capabilities (bubblewrap's default for an unprivileged caller, never overridden), so it can neither raise nor bypass a limit
open_points.question: Which module guarantees that bubblewrap is invoked by an unprivileged caller, or what must happen when the kernel itself is started with privileges?
options: `installation` or `surface` refuses startup unless the kernel process is unprivileged
`sandbox` explicitly drops all capabilities regardless of the caller's privileges
Privileged kernel execution is supported and bubblewrap's resulting capability set is specified and checked
open_points.default_guess: Have `sandbox` explicitly drop all capabilities and make the start probe verify the resulting execution has none.
